$comment: D68 (2026-06-20): setup-field taxonomy additions harvested from the VRC PRO simulator manual (vrcworld V2.1 'Components properties and set-up options' table). These are REAL RC setup parameters VRC exposes that RaceLab's 176-field rc-setup-fields.json lacked. PROVENANCE = VRC manual TAXONOMY only (parameter name + unit + range). D18/D53: VRC is a sim model, NOT a citable advice source — these fields widen the SETUP-SHEET vocabulary/option bounds; they MUST NOT be used to author cited tuning rules. Ranges are VRC-documented bounds to seed template options, to be confirmed against real manufacturer sheets before any per-model use. sim_only fields (wheel rotational inertia, brushless rotor diameter) were deliberately NOT adopted (sim-physics constructs, not real setup-sheet fields) — see VRC_HARVEST.md.

additions.label: Steering angle (total throw)
additions.note: Total steering throw. We had ackermann/bump_steer/toe but no field for absolute steering angle. VRC bounds it 22-34deg by class.

additions.label: Front sway bar disconnect
additions.note: Per-end ARB disconnect (engaged/disconnected) — distinct from sway_bar_front stiffness.

additions.label: Rear sway bar disconnect
additions.note: Per-end ARB disconnect — distinct from sway_bar_rear stiffness.

additions.label: Cylinder head shim (squish/compression)
additions.note: Nitro head-shim thickness = combustion squish/compression. We had needle_low/high and diff_height_shim (unrelated) but no head-shim/compression field.
additions.provenance: VRC manual V2.1 (nitro engine dialog, observed 0.1mm)

additions.label: Idle setting
additions.note: Dedicated idle/throttle-stop adjustment, separate from low/high-speed needles.
additions.provenance: VRC manual V2.1 (nitro engine dialog, observed 25%)

additions.label: ESC launch control (magnitude)
additions.note: Launch-control magnitude as % of max throttle. esc_boost/esc_turbo/esc_profile existed; launch percent did not.

additions.label: ESC launch duration
additions.note: Time-based launch ramp. No prior time dimension on the power profile.

additions.label: ESC initial-brake duration
additions.note: Time dimension on the initial brake pulse. brake_setup had no duration axis.

additions.label: Centre drive pulley (belt ratio)
additions.note: Belt-drive centre ratio via selectable side-pulley size — distinct from belt_tension/center_drive.

additions.label: Tyre profile / crown
additions.note: Tyre cross-section profile/crown as a setup axis (flat for smooth/on-road/oval, round for bumpy/off-road). We had tread/cut/type but no flat-vs-round profile.
